eyebrow: vim starts in normal mode, not insert
code:
$ vim app/nginx.conf
-- press i --
-- INSERT --
worker_connections 2048;
-- press Esc --
caption: Typing does nothing useful until you press i for insert mode; Esc returns you to normal mode where keystrokes are commands again.

eyebrow: Normal-mode commands that cover most editing

steps.label: yy / p
steps.sub: yank (copy) a line, then paste it

steps.label: /searchterm
steps.sub: search forward, Enter to jump to it

eyebrow: Save and quit, or abandon and quit
code:
:wq
-- writes the file and quits --

:q!
-- quits without saving, discards changes --
caption: Both start with a colon from normal mode. :wq saves first; the ! on :q! forces an exit past vim's unsaved-changes warning.

subtitle: Who can read, write, and run the files you've been editing.
